content.title: Shell Approves Waterflood Project at Kaikias Field in the US Gulf
content.summary: SHEL approves a waterflood project at the Kaikias field to lift recoverable resources and extend the Ursa platform's productive life in the Gulf of America.

content.title: Are Investors Undervaluing Oceaneering International (OII) Right Now?
content.summary: Here at Zacks, our focus is on the proven Zacks Rank system, which emphasizes earnings estimates and estimate revisions to find great stocks. Nevertheless, we are always paying attention to the latest value, growth, and momentum trends to underscore strong picks.

content.title: California Resources Signs MOU to Drive Decarbonized Power Solutions
content.summary: CRC advances its carbon management push with an MOU to deliver carbon capture and storage services to Middle River Power plants in California.

content.title: Chevron to Export 2 Billion Cubic Meters of LNG to Hungary
content.summary: CVX reportedly seals a five-year LNG deal with Hungary, supplying 2 billion cubic meters to diversify energy sources and reduce reliance on Russian gas.

content.title: Seadrill Expands Backlog With New Rig Contracts in US Gulf & Angola
content.summary: SDRL adds new drillship contracts in the Gulf of America and a contract extension in Angola, boosting backlog and extending operations through 2027.

content.title: Canadian Natural's 2026 Budget Aims to Expand Assets and Production
content.summary: CNQ targets 3% production growth in 2026 with a C$6.3B budget, disciplined capital and a balanced liquids-gas mix to drive shareholder value.

content.title: Pembina Targets Growth With Expansions and LNG Projects for 2026
content.summary: PBA maps out its 2026 growth plan with higher fee-based EBITDA, major pipeline expansions and long-term LNG contracts driving stable cash flows.

content.title: Imperial Oil Unveils Its Corporate Roadmap and Outlook for 2026
content.summary: IMO outlines its 2026 strategy, targeting higher cash flow, rising production at Kearl and Cold Lake, and disciplined capital spending to boost returns.

content.title: Equinor Approves $395M Investment to Boost Johan Castberg Production
content.summary: EQNR approves a $395M subsea investment to tie back a new Johan Castberg discovery, adding 46M barrels, with production targeted for Q4 2028.
